dedupe_keys.name: future ecological risk due to river flow alteration in the drammen river catchment

description: The STARS4Water project publishes ecological-flow risk results for seven Drammen sub-basins in Norway. Its public README describes twelve climate cases from six CMIP5 and CMIP6 global models with two bias-correction methods, followed by a local LISFLOOD flow simulation. Risk classes compare 1991 to 2020 conditions with 2021 to 2040, 2041 to 2070 and 2071 to 2100 periods. Zenodo makes a ZIP and README public under CC BY 4.0. These scenario results can help a water-allocation or hydropower simulation flag environmental-flow pressure under alternative climates. The Ecological Risk due to Flow Alteration method is a screening measure based on changed flow indicators; it is not a measured fish or habitat response. This release is derived from a separate Drammen climate and energy projection deposit. The README was read but ZIP fields, sub-basin joins and results were not opened. No catalogue record explicitly identifies this release.
